An element that isn't [[Algebraic Elements of Field|algebraic]] is called transcendent.
## Extension generated by a transcendent element
An extension $F[x]$ where $x$ is transcendent over $F$, is isomorphic to $F(x)$ where the isomorphism is substitution of $x$ in a rational function.
## Example of transcendent numbers
- $e$, $\pi$ are transcendent over $\mathbb{Q}$
